```{r bad, eval = FALSE}
soil_C_raw  <- read.csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariates_and_soil_data/soil_covariate_data_scaled_C.csv")

  rename(
    c = leco_carbon_average,
    n = leco_nitrogen_average
  )

# Split by sampling type

C_soil_with_CN  <- soil_with_CN %>% filter(type == "CID")

# Merge CN into point tables
soil_SP_full <- soil_SP_raw %>%
  select(x, y, lbc_1, lb_ceq, p_h_2, ca, k, mg, mn, p, zn) %>%

  st_transform(crs(covariate_stack))

# Extract raster covariates directly at sample points
extract_covariates_to_sf <- function(sf_obj, rast_obj) {
  vals <- terra::extract(rast_obj, terra::vect(sf_obj))
  vals <- vals %>% dplyr::select(-ID)
  bind_cols(sf_obj, vals)
}
#extracted covs per point

soil_sf_C  <- extract_covariates_to_sf(soil_sf_C,  covariate_stack)

# Define covariates from raster names only
covariates <- names(covariate_stack)

# Keep only numeric covariates that exist in both sf tables

covariates <- c(
  "elevation", "Slope", "Profile Curvature", "Plan Curvature",
```

```{r checks}
      qa_basic <- function(dat, soil_vars) {
      
      coords <- st_coordinates(dat)
      
      dat2 <- dat %>%
        mutate(
          X = coords[,1],
          Y = coords[,2]
        )
      
      # duplicate coordinates
      dup_coords <- dat2 %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        count(X, Y) %>%
        filter(n > 1)
      
      # missing values
      missing_tbl <- dat2 %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        summarise(across(all_of(soil_vars), ~sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
        pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "n_missing")
      
      # basic coordinate summary
      coord_summary <- dat2 %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        summarise(
          n_points = n(),
          x_min = min(X, na.rm = TRUE),
          x_max = max(X, na.rm = TRUE),
          y_min = min(Y, na.rm = TRUE),
          y_max = max(Y, na.rm = TRUE)
        )
      
      # nutrient summary
      nutrient_summary <- dat2 %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        summarise(across(all_of(soil_vars),
                         list(
                           mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                           sd = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                           min = ~min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                           max = ~max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
                         ))) %>%
        pivot_longer(everything(),
                     names_to = c("variable", ".value"),
                     names_sep = "_")
      
      # IQR outliers
      outlier_tbl <- map_dfr(soil_vars, function(v) {
        x <- st_drop_geometry(dat2)[[v]]
        q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
        q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
        iqr <- q3 - q1
        lower <- q1 - 1.5 * iqr
        upper <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr
        
        tibble(
          variable = v,
          n_outliers = sum(x < lower | x > upper, na.rm = TRUE),
          lower_bound = lower,
          upper_bound = upper
        )
      })
      
      list(
        duplicate_coords = dup_coords,
        missing_tbl = missing_tbl,
        coord_summary = coord_summary,
        nutrient_summary = nutrient_summary,
        outlier_tbl = outlier_tbl
      )
      }
      
      qa_SP <- qa_basic(soil_prop_SP, soil_vars)
      qa_COMP <- qa_basic(soil_prop_COMP, soil_vars)
      
      qa_SP$duplicate_coords
      qa_SP$missing_tbl
      qa_SP$coord_summary
      qa_SP$outlier_tbl
      
      qa_COMP$duplicate_coords
      qa_COMP$missing_tbl
      qa_COMP$coord_summary
      qa_COMP$outlier_tbl

  #moran's I
    moran_check <- function(dat, var, k = 5) {
      coords <- st_coordinates(dat)
      knn <- knearneigh(coords, k = k)
      nb <- knn2nb(knn)
      lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W")
      
      x <- st_drop_geometry(dat)[[var]]
      valid <- !is.na(x)
      
      moran.test(x[valid], nb2listw(knn2nb(knearneigh(coords[valid, ], k = k)), style = "W"))
    }
    moran_all <- function(dat, soil_vars, k = 5) {
      map_dfr(soil_vars, function(v) {
        res <- moran_check(dat, v, k = k)
        tibble(
          variable = v,
          moran_I = unname(res$estimate[1]),
          expectation = unname(res$estimate[2]),
          variance = unname(res$estimate[3]),
          p_value = res$p.value
        )
      })
    }

    high_cor_pairs <- function(cor_mat, cutoff = 0.8) {
      cor_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat)) %>%
        rename(var1 = Var1, var2 = Var2, cor = Freq) %>%
        filter(var1 != var2) %>%
        mutate(pair = map2_chr(var1, var2, ~paste(sort(c(.x, .y)), collapse = "___"))) %>%
        distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
        filter(abs(cor) >= cutoff)
      
      cor_df
    }
    
    high_cor_pairs(cov_cor_mat, cutoff = 0.8)
```

```{r}
#checks on residuals after RF (for RK)
#residual checks from RF model
  #skew
  #outliers
  #heavy tails?
  run_rf_residuals <- function(dat, response, cov_names, ntree = 500, seed = 123) {
  
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # keep only needed columns and complete cases
  df <- dat %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(all_of(c(response, cov_names))) %>%
    na.omit()
  
  # keep matching geometry rows
  dat_complete <- dat %>%
    filter(complete.cases(st_drop_geometry(select(., all_of(c(response, cov_names))))))
  
      rf_mod <- randomForest(
        x = df %>% select(all_of(cov_names)),
        y = df[[response]],
        ntree = ntree,
        importance = TRUE
      )
      
      preds <- predict(rf_mod, newdata = df %>% select(all_of(cov_names)))
      residuals <- df[[response]] - preds
      
      out_sf <- dat_complete %>%
        mutate(
          observed = df[[response]],
          predicted = preds,
          residual = residuals
        )
      
      list(
        model = rf_mod,
        data = out_sf
      )
    }
        rf_P_SP <- run_rf_residuals(
      dat = soil_SP_cov,
      response = "p",
      cov_names = cov_names,
      ntree = 500
    )
    
    rf_P_COMP <- run_rf_residuals(
      dat = soil_COMP_cov,
      response = "p",
      cov_names = cov_names,
      ntree = 500
    )
    rf_model_summary <- function(rf_obj) {
      dat <- rf_obj$data %>% st_drop_geometry()
      
      tibble(
        n = nrow(dat),
        RMSE = sqrt(mean((dat$observed - dat$predicted)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
        MAE = mean(abs(dat$observed - dat$predicted), na.rm = TRUE),
        R2 = cor(dat$observed, dat$predicted, use = "complete.obs")^2,
        mean_error = mean(dat$residual, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    }
    
    rf_model_summary(rf_P_SP)
    rf_model_summary(rf_P_COMP)
      varImpPlot(rf_P_SP$model, main = "RF Variable Importance - SP P")
      varImpPlot(rf_P_COMP$model, main = "RF Variable Importance - COMP P")
      
      rf_residual_summary <- function(rf_obj) {
      r <- rf_obj$data %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        pull(residual)
      
      q1 <- quantile(r, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
      q3 <- quantile(r, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
      iqr <- q3 - q1
      
      tibble(
        n = sum(!is.na(r)),
        mean_resid = mean(r, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_resid = sd(r, na.rm = TRUE),
        skewness = e1071::skewness(r, na.rm = TRUE, type = 2),
        shapiro_p = if (sum(!is.na(r)) >= 3 && sum(!is.na(r)) <= 5000) 
          shapiro.test(r)$p.value else NA_real_,
        n_iqr_outliers = sum(r < (q1 - 1.5 * iqr) | r > (q3 + 1.5 * iqr), na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    }
    
    rf_residual_summary(rf_P_SP)
    rf_residual_summary(rf_P_COMP)
    
    plot_rf_resid_hist <- function(rf_obj, title = "RF residuals") {
      rf_obj$data %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = residual)) +
        geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
        theme_minimal() +
        labs(title = title, x = "Residual", y = "Count")
    }
    
    plot_rf_resid_hist(rf_P_SP, "SP P RF residuals")
    plot_rf_resid_hist(rf_P_COMP, "COMP P RF residuals")
    plot_rf_resid_qq <- function(rf_obj, title = "RF residual QQ plot") {
      rf_obj$data %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        ggplot(aes(sample = residual)) +
        stat_qq() +
        stat_qq_line() +
        theme_minimal() +
        labs(title = title)
    }
    
    plot_rf_resid_qq(rf_P_SP, "SP P RF residual QQ plot")
    plot_rf_resid_qq(rf_P_COMP, "COMP P RF residual QQ plot")

      coords <- st_coordinates(rf_obj$data)
      r <- rf_obj$data %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%

      knn <- knearneigh(coords, k = k)
      nb <- knn2nb(knn)
      lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W")
      
      moran.test(r, lw)

      map_dfr(names(rf_list), function(v) {
        s <- rf_model_summary(rf_list[[v]])
        rs <- rf_residual_summary(rf_list[[v]])
        
        tibble(

          n = s$n,

          R2 = s$R2,
          mean_error = s$mean_error,
          resid_skewness = rs$skewness,
          resid_shapiro_p = rs$shapiro_p,

        )

          variable = v,
          moran_I = unname(mt$estimate[1]),
          expectation = unname(mt$estimate[2]),
          variance = unname(mt$estimate[3]),
          p_value = mt$p.value
        )
      })
    }
```

```{r}
inspect_close_pairs <- function(dat, response, max_dist = 100) {
  
  coords <- st_coordinates(dat)
  vals <- dat %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% pull(.data[[response]])
  ids <- seq_len(nrow(dat))
  
  dmat <- as.matrix(dist(coords))
  
  pair_idx <- which(upper.tri(dmat) & dmat <= max_dist, arr.ind = TRUE)
  
  if (nrow(pair_idx) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  tibble(
    i = pair_idx[,1],
    j = pair_idx[,2],
    id_i = ids[pair_idx[,1]],
    id_j = ids[pair_idx[,2]],
    dist = dmat[pair_idx],
    z_i = vals[pair_idx[,1]],
    z_j = vals[pair_idx[,2]],
    diff = z_i - z_j,
    abs_diff = abs(diff),
    semivariance_contribution = 0.5 * (diff^2)
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(semivariance_contribution))
}

find_repeat_offenders <- function(close_pairs_tbl) {
  bind_rows(
    close_pairs_tbl %>% count(id_i, wt = semivariance_contribution, name = "total_sv") %>% rename(id = id_i),
    close_pairs_tbl %>% count(id_j, wt = semivariance_contribution, name = "total_sv") %>% rename(id = id_j)
  ) %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    summarise(total_sv = sum(total_sv), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(total_sv))
}

vg_drop_first_if_low_np <- function(vg, frac_cutoff = 0.1, abs_cutoff = 10) {
  vg_df <- as.data.frame(vg)
  
  first_np <- vg_df$np[1]
  med_np <- median(vg_df$np[-1], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  drop_first <- first_np < abs_cutoff || first_np < frac_cutoff * med_np
  
  list(
    drop_first = drop_first,
    first_np = first_np,
    median_other_np = med_np,
    vg_out = if (drop_first) vg[-1, ] else vg
  )
}
```

```{r}
make_variograms <- function(dat_sp, soil_vars, cutoff, width) {
  purrr::map(soil_vars, function(v) {
    f <- as.formula(paste(v, "~ 1"))
    gstat::variogram(f, data = dat_sp, cutoff = cutoff, width = width)
  }) |> rlang::set_names(soil_vars)
}

fit_variogram_models <- function(vg) {
  
  vg_df <- as.data.frame(vg)
  
  init_nugget <- max(0, min(vg_df$gamma, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.5)
  init_sill   <- max(vg_df$gamma, na.rm = TRUE)
  init_psill  <- max(init_sill - init_nugget, 1e-6)
  init_range  <- max(vg_df$dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 3
  
  candidate_models <- c("Sph", "Exp", "Gau")
  
  fits <- purrr::map(candidate_models, function(m) {
    tryCatch({
      fit <- fit.variogram(
        vg,
        model = vgm(
          psill  = init_psill,
          model  = m,
          range  = init_range,
          nugget = init_nugget
        )
      )
      
      # reject bad fits
      if (any(!is.finite(fit$psill))) return(NULL)
      if (any(!is.finite(fit$range))) return(NULL)
      if (any(fit$range[fit$model != "Nug"] <= 0)) return(NULL)
      if (sum(fit$psill, na.rm = TRUE) <= 0) return(NULL)
      
      fit
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  })
  
  fits <- fits[!sapply(fits, is.null)]
  
  if (length(fits) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  sse <- sapply(fits, function(f) attr(f, "SSErr"))
  fits[[which.min(sse)]]
}

calc_nugget_ratio <- function(vgm_model) {
  if (is.null(vgm_model)) return(NA_real_)
  
  nugget <- vgm_model$psill[vgm_model$model == "Nug"]
  if (length(nugget) == 0) nugget <- 0
  
  total_sill <- sum(vgm_model$psill, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (total_sill <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  
  nugget / total_sill
}
plot_vg_with_fit <- function(vg, fit = NULL, title = "") {
  
  vg_df <- as.data.frame(vg)
  
  # draw the empirical variogram explicitly
  graphics::plot(
    vg_df$dist, vg_df$gamma,
    main = title,
    xlab = "Distance",
    ylab = "Semivariance",
    pch = 16
  )
  
  # add fitted line only if the fit is valid
  if (!is.null(fit)) {
    good_range <- all(is.finite(fit$range[fit$model != "Nug"])) &&
      all(fit$range[fit$model != "Nug"] > 0)
    
    good_psill <- all(is.finite(fit$psill)) &&
      sum(fit$psill, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
    
    if (good_range && good_psill) {
      vline <- variogramLine(fit, maxdist = max(vg_df$dist))
      
      graphics::lines(vline$dist, vline$gamma, col = "red", lwd = 2)
      
      ratio <- calc_nugget_ratio(fit)
      
      graphics::legend(
        "topright",
        legend = paste0(
          "Model: ", fit$model[fit$model != "Nug"][1],
          "\nNugget:Sill = ", round(ratio, 2)
        ),
        bty = "n"
      )
    } else {
      graphics::legend("topright", legend = "Invalid fit", bty = "n")
    }
  } else {
    graphics::legend("topright", legend = "No valid fit", bty = "n")
  }
}
fit_SP <- purrr::map(vg_SP, fit_variogram_models)
fit_COMP <- purrr::map(vg_COMP, fit_variogram_models)

extract_vg_metrics <- function(fit, var_name) {
  
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  
  nugget <- fit$psill[fit$model == "Nug"]
  if (length(nugget) == 0) nugget <- 0
  
  sill <- sum(fit$psill)
  range <- fit$range[2]
  
  tibble(
    variable = var_name,
    model = fit$model[2],
    nugget = nugget,
    sill = sill,
    range = range,
    nugget_ratio = nugget / sill
  )
}

vg_metrics_COMP <- purrr::map_dfr(names(fit_COMP), ~extract_vg_metrics(fit_COMP[[.x]], .x))

make_residuals_xy <- function(dat, soil_vars) {
  
  dat_out <- dat
  
  model_list <- purrr::map(soil_vars, function(v) {
    f <- as.formula(paste(v, "~ X + Y"))
    lm(f, data = sf::st_drop_geometry(dat_out))
  }) |> rlang::set_names(soil_vars)
  
  for (v in soil_vars) {
    resid_name <- paste0(v, "_resid")
    dat_out[[resid_name]] <- residuals(model_list[[v]])
  }
  
  list(
    data = dat_out,
    models = model_list
  )
}

make_residuals_xy <- function(dat, soil_vars) {
  
  dat_out <- dat
  
  model_list <- purrr::map(soil_vars, function(v) {
    f <- as.formula(paste(v, "~ X + Y"))
    lm(f, data = sf::st_drop_geometry(dat_out))
  }) |> rlang::set_names(soil_vars)
  
  for (v in soil_vars) {
    resid_name <- paste0(v, "_resid")
    dat_out[[resid_name]] <- residuals(model_list[[v]])
  }
  
  list(
    data = dat_out,
    models = model_list
  )
}

soil_prop_COMP_resid <- resid_COMP$data
extract_lm_metrics <- function(model, variable, dataset) {
  s <- summary(model)
  
  tibble(
    dataset = dataset,
    variable = variable,
    r2 = s$r.squared,
    adj_r2 = s$adj.r.squared,
    p_X = coef(s)["X", "Pr(>|t|)"],
    p_Y = coef(s)["Y", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  )
}
lm_metrics_SP <- purrr::map_dfr(
  names(resid_SP$models),
  ~extract_lm_metrics(resid_SP$models[[.x]], .x, "SP")
)

lm_metrics_COMP <- purrr::map_dfr(
  names(resid_COMP$models),
  ~extract_lm_metrics(resid_COMP$models[[.x]], .x, "COMP")
)

lm_metrics_all <- bind_rows(lm_metrics_SP, lm_metrics_COMP)
lm_metrics_all

resid_vars <- paste0(soil_vars, "_resid")

soil_prop_SP_resid_sp <- as(soil_prop_SP_resid, "Spatial")
soil_prop_COMP_resid_sp <- as(soil_prop_COMP_resid, "Spatial")

vg_SP_resid <- make_variograms(
  soil_prop_SP_resid_sp,
  resid_vars,
  cutoff = cutoff_SP,
  width = width_SP
)

vg_COMP_resid <- make_variograms(
  soil_prop_COMP_resid_sp,
  resid_vars,
  cutoff = cutoff_COMP,
  width = width_COMP
)

vg_SP_resid_no1 <- purrr::map(vg_SP_resid, drop_first_lag)
vg_COMP_resid_no1 <- purrr::map(vg_COMP_resid, drop_first_lag)

op <- par(mfrow = c(3, 3))
for (v in resid_vars) {
  plot_vg_with_fit(vg_SP_resid[[v]], NULL, paste("SP residual:", v))
}
par(op)

op <- par(mfrow = c(3, 3))
for (v in resid_vars) {
  plot_vg_with_fit(vg_COMP_resid[[v]], NULL, paste("COMP residual:", v))
}
par(op)

op <- par(mfrow = c(3, 3))
for (v in resid_vars) {
  plot_vg_with_fit(vg_SP_resid_no1[[v]], NULL, paste("SP residual no1:", v))
}
par(op)

op <- par(mfrow = c(3, 3))
for (v in resid_vars) {
  plot_vg_with_fit(vg_COMP_resid_no1[[v]], NULL, paste("COMP residual no1:", v))
}
par(op)

fit_SP_resid <- purrr::map(vg_SP_resid, fit_variogram_models)
fit_COMP_resid <- purrr::map(vg_COMP_resid, fit_variogram_models)

fit_SP_resid_no1 <- purrr::map(vg_SP_resid_no1, fit_variogram_models)
fit_COMP_resid_no1 <- purrr::map(vg_COMP_resid_no1, fit_variogram_models)

op <- par(mfrow = c(3, 3))

}
par(op)

extract_vg_metrics <- function(fit, var_name, dataset, stage) {
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(tibble(
      variable = var_name,
      dataset = dataset,
      stage = stage,
      model = NA_character_,
      nugget = NA_real_,
      sill = NA_real_,
      range = NA_real_,
      nugget_ratio = NA_real_,
      SSErr = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  
  nugget <- fit$psill[fit$model == "Nug"]
  if (length(nugget) == 0) nugget <- 0
  
  sill <- sum(fit$psill, na.rm = TRUE)
  range <- fit$range[fit$model != "Nug"][1]
  
  tibble(
    variable = var_name,
    dataset = dataset,
    stage = stage,
    model = fit$model[fit$model != "Nug"][1],
    nugget = nugget,
    sill = sill,
    range = range,
    nugget_ratio = nugget / sill,
    SSErr = attr(fit, "SSErr")
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Compute RF residual Moran's I fresh from the rf_all objects
rf_moran_SP_correct <- purrr::map_dfr(names(rf_all_SP), function(v) {
  coords <- st_coordinates(rf_all_SP[[v]]$data)
  r <- rf_all_SP[[v]]$data %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    pull(residual)
  knn <- knearneigh(coords, k = 5)
  nb  <- knn2nb(knn)
  lw  <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W")
  mt  <- moran.test(r, lw)
  tibble(
    variable    = v,
    moran_I     = unname(mt$estimate[1]),
    p_value     = mt$p.value
  )
})

rf_moran_COMP_correct <- purrr::map_dfr(names(rf_all_COMP), function(v) {
  coords <- st_coordinates(rf_all_COMP[[v]]$data)
  r <- rf_all_COMP[[v]]$data %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    pull(residual)
  knn <- knearneigh(coords, k = 5)
  nb  <- knn2nb(knn)
  lw  <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W")
  mt  <- moran.test(r, lw)
  tibble(
    variable    = v,
    moran_I     = unname(mt$estimate[1]),
    p_value     = mt$p.value
  )
})

print(rf_moran_SP_correct,   n = 9)
print(rf_moran_COMP_correct, n = 9)
```

```{r}
# ── Descriptive statistics table ──────────────────────────
descriptive_stats <- function(dat, soil_vars, dataset_label) {
  dat %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(all_of(soil_vars)) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(),
                 names_to  = "variable",
                 values_to = "value") %>%
    group_by(variable) %>%
    summarise(
      n      = sum(!is.na(value)),
      mean   = round(mean(value,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      sd     = round(sd(value,     na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      min    = round(min(value,    na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      median = round(median(value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      max    = round(max(value,    na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      cv_pct = round(sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) /
                     mean(value, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(dataset = dataset_label) %>%
    mutate(variable = recode(variable,
      "lbc_1"  = "Lime Buffer Capacity",
      "lb_ceq" = "LBC Equivalent",
      "p_h_2"  = "pH",
      "ca"     = "Calcium",
      "k"      = "Potassium",
      "mg"     = "Magnesium",
      "mn"     = "Manganese",
      "p"      = "Phosphorus",
      "zn"     = "Zinc"
    ))
}

desc_SP   <- descriptive_stats(soil_prop_SP,   soil_vars, "SP")
desc_COMP <- descriptive_stats(soil_prop_COMP, soil_vars, "COMP")
desc_all  <- bind_rows(desc_SP, desc_COMP)

print(desc_all, n = 18)

write.csv(desc_all, "../outputs/descriptive_statistics.csv")

# For a figure, the most useful supplement to a descriptive stats table is a paired boxplot comparing SP vs COMP distributions side by side for each variable — it visually shows the mean shift, spread reduction, and outlier differences between sampling designs in one figure:
# ── Paired SP vs COMP boxplot ─────────────────────────────
soil_var_labels <- c(
  "lbc_1"  = "Lime Buffer Capacity",
  "lb_ceq" = "LBC Equilibrium",
  "p_h_2"  = "pH",
  "ca"     = "Calcium",
  "k"      = "Potassium",
  "mg"     = "Magnesium",
  "mn"     = "Manganese",
  "p"      = "Phosphorus",
  "zn"     = "Zinc"
)

bind_rows(
  soil_prop_SP   %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(dataset = "SP"),
  soil_prop_COMP %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(dataset = "COMP")
) %>%
  select(all_of(soil_vars), dataset) %>%
  pivot_longer(-dataset,
               names_to  = "variable",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    variable = recode(variable, !!!soil_var_labels),
    variable = factor(variable, levels = soil_var_labels),
    dataset  = factor(dataset, levels = c("SP", "COMP"))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = dataset, y = value, fill = dataset)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21, outlier.size = 1.5,
               alpha = 0.7, width = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("SP"   = "#2980b9",
                                "COMP" = "#e74c3c")) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92"),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 9)
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Distribution of soil properties by sampling design",
    subtitle = "SP = single-point; COMP = composite (n = 136 each)",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Value"
  )

ggsave("../outputs/fig_descriptive_boxplots.png",
       width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```
